1,559 likes, 37 comments - italian_founder on September 26, 2026: "“I don’t have a strategy” isn’t an excuse anymore. Here are 4, with every rule. Save this.

1) Morning range breakout · USDJPY
• Mark the high and low from 03:00 to 06:00 (broker time, GMT+2/+3)
• At 06:00: buy stop at the high, sell stop at the low
• Stop loss: opposite side of the range. No take profit
• 1 trade per day. When one fills, cancel the other
• 18:00: close open trades, cancel unfilled orders

2) Turnaround Tuesday · US30
• Monday 01:05 (broker time): if price is below the 25-day SMA of closes, buy
• Close Tuesday at 23:50
• Long only. No stop, no target

3) Daily long bias · US Tech 100
• Every trading day, buy at 01:05 (broker time)
• Close the same day at 23:50
• No stop, no target, no filters

4) Opening range breakout · US Tech 100 (New York time)
• Mark the high and low from 09:30 to 09:45
• 09:45 to 15:00: buy on a 5-min close above the high, sell on a 5-min close below the low
• 1 trade per day, 1% risk
• Stop: beyond the opposite side + 0.25 × ATR(14, 5-min)
• Target: 2 × the range height, from the breakout level
• Close anything still open at 15:55

Before you trust any backtest, check 4 things:
• Costs: spread, commission (both ways), slippage, swap
• Overfitting: count every version you tried, even the deleted ones
• Trades: under 100 is a hypothesis, not a result
• Data: bars to explore, every tick to validate

Backtest results, not recommendations. Two of these have no stop loss, so size accordingly. Past performance doesn’t guarantee future results.

Which one are you testing first? 👇
